import { test } from 'node:test';
const systemCi = true;
test('a helper check', async (t) => {
  const sub = (q) => { q.plan(1); q.assert.ok(true); };
  await t.test('helper sub', sub);
});
test('base', { skip: !systemCi && 'needs systemd' }, async (t) => {
  t.plan(2);
  t.assert.ok(true);
  const sub = () => {
    if (!process.env.FIXTURE_NEVER) return;
    throw new Error('the subtest checks ran');
  };
  await t.test('the unit answers', sub);
});
